description: This is a PHP source file defining the HiringManagerAPI class within the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin. The class provides an API endpoint to list available hiring managers based on vacancy data, utilizing various service traits and implementing collection endpoint functionality.

classes.name: HiringManagerAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for retrieving hiring manager data, predominantly the list of available employees suitable for recruitment, with methods adhering to a collection endpoint interface.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all hiring managers, filtering and paginating the data based on user permissions and vacancy associations.
